decisions.reason: Because management already backed this visibly committed core upholstery launch once and can still justify staying the course in a growing market, it is likely to keep it despite somewhat higher review risk after two seasons.

This product has weaker public commitment and less functional differentiation than the others, so it faces the highest rationalization risk, but escalation of commitment and its closeness to the established decorative range still make retention more likely than withdrawal.

Its own page, flame-retardant specification and strong fit with the firm’s contract-curtain business give management strong reasons to continue supporting it and interpret any underperformance as not yet decisive.

As a 2024 launch with its own page and a clear link to the core upholstery-and-curtain assortment, it is the kind of recent, publicly backed development that management is especially prone to continue funding for at least another year.
